name: Mineralize
description: As a bonus action when it has encased a creature, the creature hardens the minerals in its body, turning the surface of its body into a stone-like material. While mineralized, the creature has a walking speed of 5 feet, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. The creature remains mineralized until the creature it has encased dies, or until the creature takes a bonus action to end it.
